label: step-001
payload: Write a file called 'parser.py' — a small line-parsing module with a module docstring and these documented functions: 'parse_line(line)' returns a dict with keys "raw" and "words" (the whitespace-split tokens); 'count_tokens(line)' returns the number of whitespace-separated tokens. Also write 'tests/test_parser.py' covering 'parse_line' and 'count_tokens'.
